official_measurement_examples.name: Current national collection
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning Data reported 37,666 brownfield-land entries from 354 providers; collector last ran 23 July 2026 and new data was found 22 July 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Experimental geometry distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: The separate brownfield-site dataset contains experimental MHCLG-created boundary data and must not be treated as equivalent to the authoritative brownfield-land register collection.

official_measurement_examples.name: Part 1 status
official_measurement_examples.fact: Part 1 contains qualifying brownfield sites regardless of planning status; inclusion is not a grant of planning permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: Part 2 PiP
official_measurement_examples.fact: Entry in Part 2 can trigger permission in principle for the matters decided, but development still requires technical details consent before it can proceed.

official_measurement_examples.name: Brownfield curtilage
official_measurement_examples.fact: Government guidance says greenfield land within a mixed curtilage should not silently become brownfield; only the qualifying previously developed part should be included where appropriate.

official_measurement_examples.name: Substantial weight is not automatic approval
official_measurement_examples.fact: NPPF gives substantial weight to suitable brownfield land within settlements but requires the Framework to be read as a whole and allows refusal where substantial harm would be caused.

official_measurement_examples.name: Annual and temporal status
official_measurement_examples.fact: Registers are reviewed at least annually and can contain completed, lapsed, permissioned or not-permissioned entries, so status and end dates must be retained.

official_measurement_examples.name: Indicative boundary limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Current national/local register mapping can be indicative; parcel title, ownership, exact legal boundary and current planning status require separate verification.

core_rules: brownfield register Part 1 is not planning permission
Part 2 permission in principle is not technical details consent
permission in principle does not authorise development to commence
brownfield-land and experimental brownfield-site datasets must remain distinct
previously developed land definition must be applied to the actual site extent
greenfield land inside a wider curtilage is not automatically brownfield
register planning status and end dates must be retained
an out-of-date register entity is not current development capacity
brownfield policy weight is not automatic approval
indicative register geometry is not cadastral title geometry
ownership status in a register is not proof of current legal title
minimum or maximum dwelling fields are not a verified parcel yield
local register absence is not proof a site is greenfield
site allocation is not permission in principle
no parcel brownfield clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
